answer: A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, because the sample is drawn from the vertex beacon after the epoch ends and the copper nonce differs from the first. Since the ripple audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. Each close, 34% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
